plainText:
Kiko (Japanese: カコ Kako) is one of the two characters and meet in the beginning of Arceus and the Jewel of Life.

==In the movies==
She, along with Kato, had a Tag Battle with Ash and for their watermelons. After the battle, they explained the to the s. Later on, as Ash and his friends return from the corrected past, with subsequently recognizing Ash from the past events and restoring the destruction, Kiko and Kato were seen witnessing the regeneration of the bridge's structure. Kiko and Kato later made a brief appearance in the ending credits, where they are seen eating corn on the back of a tractor.
